biography.value: Slaad lords make death slaadi by pouring part of their chaotic energy into gray slaadi. Whenever slaadi act with purpose as a group, death slaadi are often the ones behind the plan.

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. Until the start of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn, the target has a condition determined by rolling 1d4: on a 1, Charmed; on a 2, Frightened; on a 3, Poisoned; or on a 4, Incapacitated.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]):

At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detect Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectThou]{Detect Thoughts}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplInvisibili]{Invisibility} (self only), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMageHand00]{Mage Hand}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMajorImage]{Major Image}

1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplBlight0000]{Blight} (level 8 version), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCloudkill0]{Cloudkill} (level 6 version), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFly0000000]{Fly}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplPlaneShift]{Plane Shift}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplTongues000]{Tongues}

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.
